svg.text: Three independent chargers on the front-wall board, each with its own MIDI fuse to the system busbars (sheet E2).
Generated by tools/wiring/diagram.py from cad/fitout/wiring.py — cable IDs and lengths
match bom/cable-schedule-v0.11.csv. Measurements still [EST] until confirmed on the vehicle.
230 V work: licensed electrician only (AS/NZS 3000 · AS/NZS 3001.2). Not certified.
LEGEND · line weight ∝ conductor size · ID · size tags = cable schedule IDs · purple ▶◀ = detachable connector · yellow flags = continues on another sheet
Absorption / float / no temperature compensation set to iTechworld's LiFePO₄ figures in all three chargers (the BMS has no Victron link).
Orion XS: charger mode, input current limit 25–30 A until the alternator rating is known; engine running detected by IGN on H.
DVCC on with the SmartShunt as the battery monitor (Venus OS ≥ 3.20). QP1/QP2 are 2-pole DC isolators for servicing.
